windows.label: Windows
windows.install_note: Run the setup file. Windows may identify CaveViewer as an unrecognized app.

security.explanation: Microsoft does not yet recognize its publisher. Confirm that the installer came from the official CaveViewer site before proceeding.
security.action: Depending on your Windows version, select More info → Run anyway.

macos.label: macOS
macos.detail: Choose Apple silicon or Intel Mac
macos.install_note: Choose the download for Apple silicon or Intel Mac, then drag CaveViewer into Applications. macOS may be unable to verify CaveViewer.
macos.help: Check Apple menu → About This Mac. Look for “Chip” or “Processor.”

security.explanation: Apple does not yet recognize its developer.
security.action: After confirming the download source, go to System Settings → Privacy & Security → Open Anyway. Do not override a warning that says the app will damage your computer.

linux.label: Linux
linux.install_note: Allow the x86_64 AppImage to run, then open it. Linux does not display an equivalent publisher-verification warning.
